verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PTO policy setup with configurable policy details (name, dates, type) and timecard sync, and describe navigating to Time Off > Policies > Add Policy, implying integration with payroll via timecard sync. However, evidence doesn't explicitly detail accrual rule configuration or an approval workflow for PTO requests tied automatically into payroll processing. missing for 10: explicit accrual rate/rollover configuration details, explicit manager approval workflow documentation, confirmation that approved PTO automatically flows into payroll without manual reconciliation.
